scope: Fresh measurements against main 1e39b5d using its hash-matched installed release. Five counterbalanced pairs, five loop kernels in fresh engine processes, default and optimizing-only V8 separate, nine fresh-process compilation families. Exact reference/checksum checks and required ownership boundaries included. K1 --opt=off; main default pipeline, no prelude, one frontend/semantic worker. All 209 records retained, including 19 separately instrumented phase samples. Compile-suite runtime sweeps are correctness controls, not runtime evidence. No compiler changes, gdev migration, retained-edit or compiler rebuild-time measurement. CPU placement/frequency/load/cache uncontrolled; paired ranges are not confidence intervals.
